patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Microsoft Teams is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Microsoft Teams is narrower/specialist.. Choose Microsoft Teams only if your buying job matches “M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on ” rather than Nextiva's shape. Choose Nextiva only if your buying job matches “SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/mo” rather than Microsoft Teams's shape. Workflow advantage: Microsoft Teams leans shared coverage; Nextiva leans business-phone, customer-messaging. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; Microsoft Teams is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Microsoft Teams is M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on — free Teams tier exists; Phone Standard ~$10/user; Nextiva is SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/month annual, with messaging apps including WhatsApp.
- Company-size focus: Microsoft Teams (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Nextiva (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Microsoft Teams-leaning — vs Nextiva-leaning business-phone, customer-messaging, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Microsoft Teams — Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; Nextiva — Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included.

Limitations — Microsoft Teams: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; Teams Phone requires an eligible Teams/M365 licence plus PSTN (PAYG or Calling Plan); Nextiva: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from $99/mo.

Poor-fit cases: Microsoft Teams is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job · Nextiva is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included · Avoid Microsoft Teams if you actually need Nextiva's motion (SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 p)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
